messages:
Nina: Opening SolarisBank POC thread. They sent back the enterprise auth checklist. Asks: SCIM delta/throughput, SAML attribute examples, RBAC mapping policy, domain ownership proof method, and whether Dedicated changes login flows. Also need a POC pricing ballpark. @Omar @Rina can you advise?

Omar: SCIM defaults: delta_window=900s (15m). For Dedicated we can configure to 300s. Default throughput is 200 req/min/tenant; POC can be bumped to 500 req/min for the duration. Recommend SCIM batching for initial seed.

Rina: RBAC: we accept roles via SAML attribute 'roles' (comma-separated) and via SCIM groups. Important: we require an explicit mapping file; we do not infer admin roles. Delegated-admin must be requested and has extra audit trails.

Carlos: Hosted vs Dedicated: functionally identical for SSO/SCIM. Dedicated allows custom KMS, VPC egress, and tunable SCIM limits. For fallback auth: Hosted supports email magic-link when enabled; Dedicated supports it if network/email egress permits.

Nina: SolarisBank specifically asked: can SCIM provide incremental sync with 60s window? They want near-real-time for group changes.

Omar: We can provision a 60s delta_window for Dedicated under POC with a note: this increases load and we monitor CPU/memory on the POC pool. For Hosted we can do 5m minimum right now.

Nina: Good. Security Q: which domain verification flows do we offer? They need to show ownership for subdomains used in emails.

Rina: We provide DNS TXT verification, HTTP token verification for web assets, and signed SAML metadata as proof. For email subdomains DNS TXT is the recommended route.

sec-bot: Reminder: please attach completed security questionnaire PDF to the thread before sending to customer.

Carlos: POC sizing request: please provide expected total users, peak sync QPS, and number of groups. That drives whether we keep the SCIM bump at 500 or higher.

Nina: I'll collect numbers. For the pricing ask: Sales note - Hosted POC: usage + complimentary credits for 30d trial. Dedicated POC: short-term monthly commit, pricing varies by GPU/throughput; SE will propose band once we have sizing.

Omar: Quick SCIM sample we use for docs: PATCH /scim/v2/Users
body: [ { "op": "replace", "path": "name.givenName", "value": "Ari" } ]

Nina: Action items: @Omar confirm Dedicated 60s delta support SLA and any cost uplift; @Rina draft the RBAC mapping example and SAML attribute snippet; @Carlos produce quick sizing checklist; I'll gather SolarisBank counts and upload questionnaire.

Nina: Thanks team :thumbsup:
